movers.text: Paul George (30.1 mpg, rest) and Mitchell Robinson (17.5, illness) were ruled out at GS on 11/22 (WEEI via ESPN, evening report).
Cameron Boozer (30.8 mpg, ankle) and Jerami Grant (22.1, calf) are ruled out at CHA on 11/23; Scotty Pippen Jr. (back) is still week-to-week.
Grayson Allen (27.2 mpg, concussion) and Grant Williams (22.0, hamstring) are out vs MEM on 11/23; Dennis Schroder (30.0, hamstring) remains out. Brandon Miller is probable.
Austin Reaves (35.2 mpg, heel) has missed 3 games but was a full participant in Sunday's practice (LA Times via ESPN, 11/22).
Jaylen Brown (34.7 mpg) and Dean Wade (26.7), both hamstring, are probable vs POR on 11/23 after missing two games each.
